owner_decision: D-0044: documented research-unit homes are valid allocations; keep no_academic_department explicit
unit_of_count: One canonical school-lab once. Extra affiliations do not create extra labs.
detection_steps: Compare named academic appointments across official profiles and faculty rosters, using canonical unit aliases and existing accepted PI identities.
Keep source dates and explicitly stated appointment intervals. A later departmental move is not automatically a joint appointment.
Resolve primary from explicit primary or tenure-line language, or a single academic title with other roles expressly secondary. Never use title order.
Treat also entries and joint wording as candidates for source review; do not assume every listed unit is a second department.

Audit 50 seeded rows across explicit unresolved groups, joint/order signals, other affiliations, and a comparison group with no second affiliation recorded. Bind verdicts to the exact inventory and allocation hashes.

recommended_policy.university_totals: Deduplicate school-labs; total weight one per lab.
recommended_policy.department_main_view: Use a source-reviewed primary when available; retain a visible bucket for primary not recorded as resolved. Existing status flags are not fresh source certification.
recommended_policy.sensitivity_view: Compare the reporting label with 1/k membership across structurally valid, explicit primary-candidate sets. Exclude malformed, affiliate-marked or incomplete groups from splitting. This comparison holds untyped legacy reporting units fixed.
recommended_policy.other_affiliations: Store source-backed roles, dates and units as attributes. Do not silently turn courtesy, center, administrative, external or historical roles into extra academic departments.
recommended_policy.future_scientific_test: After role review, compare downstream estimates under primary and fractional-joint definitions. Report denominator changes and sensitivity; full-count departmental displays require deduplicated university totals.

priority_queue: Review primary-by-position and uncoded joint-wording flags, allowing overlap.
Classify explicit unresolved groups as simultaneous joints, conflicting sources or historical moves.
Backfill legacy primary-basis metadata from original appointment evidence; absence of a basis does not prove cross-listing.
Classify all also affiliations by actual role; their count is not a count of cross-listed academic appointments.
original_source_review_scope: The 62 final-batch records were independently checked against original HTTP200 captures; inherited records receive structural/status checks in this run, not fresh original-source certification.
counts_status: Projected sealed checkpoint; crosslisting-summary.json after live application is authoritative if concurrent inventory changes.
invariants: Each lab has an accepted home allocation with complete recorded evidence.
Every counting view conserves one lab per school and globally.
Only explicit primary candidates passing structural/role checks are split fractionally.
Research-unit exceptions remain explicit under D-0044.
Unknown roles and primaries are never filled by list order.
